# CSOAI — Council of Sovereign AI

> CSOAI is a measurement body for AI compliance. We publish frozen benchmark harnesses,
> run models against them under deterministic conditions, and sign the results
> (Ed25519) so any third party can recompute our claims instead of trusting them.

## What CSOAI does

- Publishes open benchmark harnesses (frozen splits, pinned seeds, published CIs)
- Measures models and agent systems against them; publishes measured results only
- Signs result artefacts so evidence is verifiable, not asserted
- Maintains a live leaderboard of measured results at https://csoai.org/api/leaderboard
- Tracks EU AI Act provision changes and re-fires affected measurements

## What CSOAI does not do

- No certification, accreditation, or enforcement authority — we measure; we publish
  harnesses; others recompute
- No accuracy numbers without confidence intervals and a published split
- No unmeasured capability claims

## Public benchmarks (harness + measured artefacts)

- ProvBench — EU AI Act Article 50 provenance-marking survival under real-world
  transforms (pre-registered; harness: https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/provbench)
- AI Act frozen-split harness — closed-book statutory citation measurement
  (https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/aiact-frozen-split-harness)
- GovBench — AI governance knowledge measurement
  (https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/govbench)
- CompBench — compliance reasoning measurement
  (https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/compbench)
- SwarmBench — collective-uplift and n_eff measurement protocol for agent swarms
  (https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/swarmbench)
- AIR-Bench eu_mandatory measured run — refusal-safety rows, resumable checkpoint
  (https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/airbench-eu-mandatory-run)
- lm-eval official-format results — arc_easy / arc_challenge / hellaswag, full splits
  (https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/lmeval-official-format)

## Models

- csoai/sov33-unified — governance-tuned specialist model
  (https://huggingface.co/csoai/sov33-unified)
- csoai/sov34-1p5b — experimental research model with an honest, measured model card
  (https://huggingface.co/csoai/sov34-1p5b)

## Endpoints

- https://csoai.org/api/leaderboard — measured results readout (JSON)
- https://csoai.org/api/health — liveness only
- https://csoai.org/llms.txt — this file

## Surfaces

- https://csoai.org — measurement body
- https://openmoe.ai — SwarmBench
- https://proofof.ai — provenance and attestation
- https://asisecurity.ai — AI security evidence

## Register

All public claims follow one rule: measured, signed, recompute-able — or not published.
If you find a claim on our surfaces that does not meet that rule, it is a bug;
report it via https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG/csoai-static-deploy2/issues
